headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong top‑line gains while the larger players saw modest expansion.
summary: Coforge led the pack with over 50% revenue growth, driven by AI‑centric services. Mid‑size peers LTM and Tech Mahindra posted double‑digit growth, whereas the mega‑caps Infosys and Wipro grew below 2% YoY. Profitability improved at HCLTech and OFSS, but margin expansion was limited for most firms. Guidance remains cautious, with most companies targeting low‑single‑digit FY27 growth.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins stayed flat or slipped for most, except OFSS which posted a high 47.8% margin.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Revenue grew 11.5% YoY, profit jumped 21% and AI revenue contributed significantly.

laggards.why: Revenue grew only 1.5% YoY and profit rose modestly 6%, with FY27 guidance cut to 1‑2%.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and guidance is neutral with flat‑to‑down outlook.
